profile.summary:
Hi! I'm Anya and I graduated from The University of Texas at Austin in 2024 with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and a minor in Business. I have interests in distributed systems, mobile app/web development, and building and innovating products in entrepreneurial spaces.

You can reach me at anyarobinson@utexas.edu!

projects.title: Data Analysis Build Team, Engineer & Product Manager
projects.description:
- Conducted customer interviews for user research and led A/B testing to determine which UI version performed better for Home, Search, and Results pages based on customer satisfaction improving by 200%
- Collected, cleaned, and interpreted data from the Twitter API to generate datasets in order to optimize engagement for users through an interactive web app using Python (pandas) and ReactJS

projects.title: Public Health Build Team, Engineer & Product Manager
projects.description:
- Created customer personas/user stories, workflows, and wireframes to prototype, design, and deliver the UI and UX of the product in Figma
- Designed a React-Native front-end mobile application that allows users to browse and find drug data easily
- Wrote collection scripts in JavaScript to parse and send data from the OpenFDA API to a Firebase backend
- Performed market analysis and developed a freemium business model for the product
